INSERT INTO nft_mints (
  mint_id,
  token_id,
  contract_address,
  network,
  collection_name,
  nft_name,
  nft_description,
  image_ipfs_hash,
  metadata_ipfs_hash,
  transaction_hash,
  block_number,
  gas_used,
  status,
  opensea_url,
  minting_time_ms
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.mint_id }}',
  '{{ $json.nft_data.token_id }}',
  '{{ $json.nft_data.contract_address }}',
  '{{ $json.nft_data.network }}',
  '{{ $json.nft_data.collection }}',
  '{{ $json.nft_data.name }}',
  '{{ $json.nft_data.description }}',
  '{{ $json.ipfs_data.image_hash }}',
  '{{ $json.ipfs_data.metadata_hash }}',
  '{{ $json.blockchain_data.transaction_hash }}',
  {{ $json.blockchain_data.block_number }},
  {{ $json.blockchain_data.gas_used }},
  '{{ $json.blockchain_data.status }}',
  '{{ $json.marketplace_urls.opensea }}',
  {{ $json.metadata.minting_time_ms }}
) RETURNING *;
